restrictions: Fixed-IV SHA-256, first 40 steps, standard feed-forward, equality of all 256 output bits; two 64-byte blocks per message, both blocks differ.

Block 2 is the 39-step characteristic of ePrint 2026/1120 (Tables 21/23) moved up one step: messages N = (W_-1, W0..W14) with W_-1 = W15 - s1(W13) - W8 - s0(W0); round constants K1..K39 on its last 39 steps; N0 carries the single-bit difference +0x40000000.

Block 1 is found by the distinguished-point walk of entry df1f1cd1 on the 254-bit map psi(x) = (a..g, h mod 2^30) of the 40-step output; a collision has h difference uniform on {0, 2^30, 2^31, 3*2^30}: 0 is a full 40-step collision, +-2^30 (= 0xc0000000 after ordering the pair) feeds block 2, 2^31 is discarded.

Prices as in the board's best R40 walk (0xplemonade 123.90702, credited; our df1f1cd1 123.90711) for block 1 and 9993eaa8 (116.58624, in 40-step units 116.5437) for block 2; one driver with one shared work budget W halts at success or when work reaches W (as 9993eaa8 section 7); the two parts share the 2^20-byte walk memory.

heuristics.statement: df1f1cd1's random-function premise holds for the 254-bit map psi (the 40-step output with h's top two bits dropped); 3/4 of its collisions are usable.
Premises H1 (claw model), H2 (tail p >= 2^-74.3238), H3 (advice construction) and H5 (group independence) of 9993eaa8 hold with round constants K1..K39 in place of K0..K38.
heuristics.extrapolation: constants change value conditions only, never the signed differences
heuristics.limitations: rows <= 16 measured (3/3 SAT, 0 violations); tail junction histograms J20-J26 measured equal to the K0 tail (2^30 samples each); claw rates declared

heuristics.statement: Every verified factory R39 pair is a distinct block-2 advice pair with its own row-8 state, and block 2 run on it yields claw groups at r39's measured rate of 2^15.85 groups per 2^32 window of N0.
heuristics.scope: block 2 of this construction on constants K1..K39
heuristics.extrapolation: from 541 verified factory pairs and 60 of 60 screened transplants to the 2^72.8 pairs the construction uses
heuristics.limitations: the per-pair construction cost is charged at the factory rate stated in Section 4c

heuristics.statement: Claw groups obtained from distinct advice pairs are independent for the success count of the shared-budget model.
heuristics.limitations: declared premise; each advice pair has its own row-8 state
